CandidateCustomSkillRead.title: CandidateCustomSkillRead
CandidateCustomSkillRead.description: Exact normalized custom text is grouped without catalog matching or inference.

CandidateCustomSkillSourceRead.title: CandidateCustomSkillSourceRead
CandidateCustomSkillSourceRead.description: Explicit custom skill text from the user or a project.

CandidateProfileRead.title: CandidateProfileRead
CandidateProfileRead.description: The authenticated user's derived profile view. It creates no new facts.

CandidateResumeEvidenceRead.title: CandidateResumeEvidenceRead
CandidateResumeEvidenceRead.description: Version-scoped parser evidence; source text only, never extracted document text.

CandidateResumeEvidenceSkillRead.title: CandidateResumeEvidenceSkillRead
CandidateResumeEvidenceSkillRead.description: A parser-recognized catalog skill in one evidence item.

CandidateSkillRead.title: CandidateSkillRead
CandidateSkillRead.description: A catalog skill reconciled by exact skill ID, never inferred capability.

CandidateSkillSourceRead.title: CandidateSkillSourceRead
CandidateSkillSourceRead.description: One immutable source for a reconciled catalog skill.

CompleteOnboardingRequest.title: CompleteOnboardingRequest
CompleteOnboardingRequest.description: No user ID or client timestamp is accepted.

FitAnalysisRead.title: FitAnalysisRead
FitAnalysisRead.description: Read-only evidence coverage for one active shared job listing.

FitRequirementRead.title: FitRequirementRead
FitRequirementRead.description:
One job requirement and the recorded evidence, if any.

For ``SKILL`` requirements, ``requirement_id`` is the canonical catalog
``skill_id``. It is the same identifier used for exact evidence matching.

JobAlertRead.title: JobAlertRead
JobAlertRead.description: One delivered private alert joined to current canonical job presentation.

JobAlertReadUpdate.title: JobAlertReadUpdate
JobAlertReadUpdate.description: Delivered alerts may be marked read; unread is not an alert replay.

JobUserStateRead.title: JobUserStateRead
JobUserStateRead.description: The authenticated user's private state for one canonical job.

JobUserStateUpdate.title: JobUserStateUpdate
JobUserStateUpdate.description: An idempotent patch; viewed may only be marked, never fabricated.

legal_first_name.title: Legal First Name
legal_first_name.description: Required on first save; cannot clear

legal_last_name.title: Legal Last Name
legal_last_name.description: Required on first save; cannot clear

PublicJobDetailRead.title: PublicJobDetailRead
PublicJobDetailRead.description: A shared listing's canonical detail, without private source internals.

PublicJobEducationRequirementRead.title: PublicJobEducationRequirementRead
PublicJobEducationRequirementRead.description: An explicit education requirement from the normalized job record.

PublicJobEligibilityRequirementRead.title: PublicJobEligibilityRequirementRead
PublicJobEligibilityRequirementRead.description: An explicit eligibility requirement without private source evidence.

PublicJobRead.title: PublicJobRead
PublicJobRead.description: A current canonical listing plus the requesting user's private state.

PublicJobSearchRead.title: PublicJobSearchRead
PublicJobSearchRead.description: One deterministic, server-filtered page of canonical jobs.

PublicJobSkillRequirementRead.title: PublicJobSkillRequirementRead
PublicJobSkillRequirementRead.description: An explicit canonical skill requirement, not a candidate capability claim.

ResumeAlignmentRead.title: ResumeAlignmentRead
ResumeAlignmentRead.description: Derived evidence coverage for one owned resume version and one active job.

ResumeAlignmentRequirementRead.title: ResumeAlignmentRequirementRead
ResumeAlignmentRequirementRead.description: One explicit job requirement grouped by deterministic recorded evidence.

ResumeDraftItemRead.title: ResumeDraftItemRead
ResumeDraftItemRead.description: One safe drafting outcome for a job requirement and selected resume version.

ResumeEvidenceItemRead.title: ResumeEvidenceItemRead
ResumeEvidenceItemRead.description: Source-ordered parser evidence belonging to exactly one resume version.

ResumeEvidenceSkillRead.title: ResumeEvidenceSkillRead
ResumeEvidenceSkillRead.description: A catalog match detected in one evidence item, never a confirmed user skill.

ResumeExtractedTextRead.title: ResumeExtractedTextRead
ResumeExtractedTextRead.description: Private, normalized text from one owned parsed resume version.

ResumeImprovementActionRead.title: ResumeImprovementActionRead
ResumeImprovementActionRead.description: One conservative action derived from a deterministic requirement outcome.

ResumeImprovementPlanRead.title: ResumeImprovementPlanRead
ResumeImprovementPlanRead.description: Derived actions for one active job and one owned resume version.

ResumeTailoringDraftRead.title: ResumeTailoringDraftRead
ResumeTailoringDraftRead.description: Derived, non-persistent resume tailoring content for one owned version.

ResumeTailoringReviewCreate.title: ResumeTailoringReviewCreate
ResumeTailoringReviewCreate.description: Select an owned immutable resume version for a new review snapshot.

ResumeTailoringReviewItemRead.title: ResumeTailoringReviewItemRead
ResumeTailoringReviewItemRead.description: Immutable system snapshot plus the user's separately stored review state.

ResumeTailoringReviewItemUpdate.title: ResumeTailoringReviewItemUpdate
ResumeTailoringReviewItemUpdate.description: A user decision and/or user-authored wording, never evidence input.

ResumeTailoringReviewRead.title: ResumeTailoringReviewRead
ResumeTailoringReviewRead.description: A stable saved review for a job and selected resume version.

SavedSearchCriteria.title: SavedSearchCriteria
SavedSearchCriteria.description: Portable structured criteria for a filter-first job feed.

SkillGapAnalysisRead.title: SkillGapAnalysisRead
SkillGapAnalysisRead.description: Derived gaps for one active job and one owned resume version.

SkillGapRequirementRead.title: SkillGapRequirementRead
SkillGapRequirementRead.description: One explicit requirement grouped by deterministic recorded evidence.

onboarding_completed_at.title: Onboarding Completed At
onboarding_completed_at.description: First explicit onboarding completion, or null when incomplete

status.title: Status
